description: OWS (rear-door open warning) surface drawn (simplest drivable state). DI_AEC_OWS_Show (diAEControl.cpp L788) shows when val_power==3 (POWER_ON) && val_gear==1; the getters read CycleSignal.RRadarDOWWarningLeftS/RightS -> sta_owsLeftShow/sta_owsRightShow = value iff in {1,2}. OWS CAN anchors code-confirmed: RRadar_DOW_WarningLeft_S = signal_id 0x418 sub-bits 4.0-4.1, RightS = 0x418 4.2-4.3. Drive the left DOW slot regular (1) -> OWS warning texture renders. This is the only surface requiring gear==1, which the master and DOW frames satisfy.

can.desc: RRadar_DOW_WarningLeft_S = 1 (regular) -> sta_owsLeftShow=1, OWS left warning shown
gear==1, required by the OWS show gate (val_gear==1)

mem.desc: POWER_ON required by the OWS show gate
